source_version: Theory of Computing15(2019),Article3; final publisher source September12,2019
title: Explicit Koszul flattening rank bounds beyond ordinary catalecticants

standard_prerequisites.name: Symmetric tensors, homogeneous polynomials and elementary linear/representation algebra
standard_prerequisites.statement: Original definitions and all selected source-local constructions retained.
standard_prerequisites.use: No collector reproof or author computation rerun; numerical examples remain uncounted context.

core_obligations: The authors construct independent exterior-derivative images using symmetric-group decompositions and the explicit odd-degree polynomial flattening structure, yielding the original n>2 and q<n/2 Koszul-rank bound and its border-rank implication. Rank bound and direct implication are one object; computer experiments and conjectural sharpness are not counted.

dedup.scope: No DOI, article title, Mulmuley or Gesmundo match in public/worklist metadata. This source contributes three distinct primary targets: an all-orders no-go comparison for IMM, complete-symmetric catalecticant rank, and a Koszul-rank construction. They are not direct consequences of each other; supporting maximal-rank families and restatements are not extra counts.
